content: Peerspace - the closest analog. Host-facing listing statuses: Pending approval (under review OR needs updates), Active, Paused (by host), Deactivated (by host), Paused by Peerspace, Deactivated by Peerspace. Review SLA is published (most new submissions AND resubmissions reviewed within 1 hour during operating hours). Two outcomes only: approved, or 'Updates required to get your space live' - an email naming the changes, after which the host edits and RESUBMITS. Note Peerspace overloads one status for 'we are looking' and 'your move', and splits host-initiated from platform-initiated states in the status vocabulary itself.
